backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing booking and review management with Map storage, including functions to add/approve/delete reviews, add bookings, and query reviews by service/rating/approval status.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three features: replacing category card images with professional photos, applying premium gradient backgrounds across all pages, and implementing cache-busting for UI refresh.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend components and pages, describing the React Router setup, layout components, service pages, booking/contact forms, and review functionality with glassmorphism styling.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining colors for background, foreground, cards, borders, and component styling using oklch color space.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with cache-busting meta tags (no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate) and root div for React mounting.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app with TanStack Router configuration defining six routes (Home, Services, Pricing, Booking, Contact, Reviews) wrapped in Layout component with scroll-to-top functionality.
frontend/src/components/FeaturedReviewsC: Carousel component displaying up to 6 featured approved reviews with auto-loop, navigation arrows, star ratings, and glassmorphism card styling using shadcn/ui components.
frontend/src/components/FloatingWhatsApp: Fixed bottom-right floating WhatsApp button with official green color (#25D366), pulse animation, notification badge, and link to wa.me/918884447229.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying company info, contact details (phone, email, address), quick navigation links, social media icons, and a service availability banner. Includes WhatsApp integration and payment method icons.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Hero section component with full-width background image, gradient overlay, animated heading/text, and a prominent 'Book Now' call-to-action button linking to the booking page.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout wrapper component that provides consistent structure with Navbar, Footer, FloatingWhatsAppButton, and a watermarked TrustFix logo background across all pages.
frontend/src/components/Navbar.tsx: Sticky navigation bar with logo, desktop/mobile menus, search functionality with dropdown results, and scroll-based styling changes. Includes active link highlighting and responsive design.
frontend/src/components/PricingCard.tsx: Card component displaying individual service pricing information including name, category, description, starting price, and a 'Book Service' button that links to booking with pre-selected service.
frontend/src/components/ReviewCard.tsx: Card component for displaying customer reviews with avatar, name, service type, star rating, review text, and submission date.
frontend/src/components/ServiceCard.tsx: Card component for service listings featuring an image, category badge, service name, description, starting price, and 'Book Now' button with hover effects.
frontend/src/components/ServiceCategoryG: Grid layout displaying eight service categories (Pest Control, Carpentry, Cleaning, etc.) with images, icons, and scroll-triggered animations. Handles image loading errors with fallback icon display.
frontend/src/components/StarRating.tsx: Reusable star rating component supporting both interactive and read-only modes, displaying 1-5 stars with optional click handlers for rating selection.
frontend/src/components/SuccessPopup.tsx: Modal popup component displaying success messages with animated checkmark icon, auto-dismissing after 5 seconds, and manual close button.
React form component for submitting customer reviews with fields for name, service selection, star rating, review text, and optional photo upload. Uses useReviewSubmission hook to handle form submission and displays a success popup on completion.
frontend/src/data/services.ts: Static data export containing service catalog organized by categories (Pest Control, Carpentry, Cleaning, Electrical, AC Services) with each service having name, description, price, and image path.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, automatically invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
Custom hook for handling booking form submissions that sends data to the backend actor and opens WhatsApp with a prefilled message containing booking details.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for managing Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, identity state management, and AuthClient configuration with delegation handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching approved reviews across all service types and retrieving all bookings from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useReviewSubmission.t: Custom hook for submitting customer reviews to the backend, handling photo uploads as ExternalBlob, and invalidating the reviews query cache on successful submission.
frontend/src/hooks/useSearchServices.ts: Debounced search hook that filters services from servicesData based on query string matching against service name, category, or description.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom TrustFix brand colors in OKLCH format for light/dark modes, glassmorphism utilities, premium gradient backgrounds, and custom animations including fade-in, slide-up, and wave-in effects.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient provider for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication, then renders the App component.
frontend/src/pages/Booking.tsx: Booking form page that allows users to submit service requests with name, phone, email, service selection, address, and message fields; includes success popup and pre-fills service from URL query params.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact page displaying company contact information (phone, email, location) with WhatsApp integration, Google Maps embed, and a contact form with basic alert-based submission.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page featuring hero section, service category grid, and customer reviews carousel with intersection observer for scroll animations.
frontend/src/pages/Pricing.tsx: Pricing page displaying all services organized by category with pricing cards and a disclaimer that final prices depend on inspection.
frontend/src/pages/Reviews.tsx: Reviews page showing approved customer reviews with filtering by service category, average rating display, and a form for writing new reviews.
frontend/src/pages/Services.tsx: Services page displaying all available services in a tabbed interface with category filtering and support for pre-selecting categories via URL query params.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color scheme (including trustfix-green and trustfix-orange), extended shadows for glass morphism effects, animations, and responsive container settings.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file for TrustFix Home Services web application, documenting a React + TypeScript frontend with Motoko backend, 6 pages with glassmorphism design, booking/review systems, and WhatsApp integration. Contains architectural notes, known issues (blank category images, white background instead of gradient), and requirements for 8 professional service photos at 800x600px.
